title: Deferred versus Immediate scale-down
provenance: Recorded Kubernetes API acquisitions with real readiness probes. Independent runs are aligned to their recorded demand-update completion, not a shared synthetic checkpoint. Raw source hashes and the portable trace are retained in the exported source document.
Independent runs aligned to recorded demand completion. Squares use pseudonymized observed group and Pod identities; no unobserved groups are invented.
Playback is retimed to match the scale-up illustration for readability. Recorded timestamps and event order are unchanged; the two examples do not share a real-time playback scale.

source.format: Finite Canvas primitives, original state boundaries, 24fps sampled decorative motion. No domain calculations at playback.
